Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: explicitly NON-CANON North Garden future LitRPG concept l001; not CH05 production art and not a ComicPanelPlan.
Primary request: Non-canon future Soren equipment concept. Show one clearly adult fictional man in a confident three-quarter full-body stance. Preserve his wavy light-brown/dark-blond hair, light stubble, weathered adult face, and pale oatmeal color identity. Evolve the work coat into a knee-length reinforced oatmeal-gray gambeson coat with removable dark-brown leather shoulder and forearm plates, muted blue underlayers, brass utility buckles, mud-ready boots, and a compact tool roll. Give him one practical ash-wood survey spear with a short steel head and one sheathed carpenter's hatchet; no oversized weapon. The silhouette should feel like a working engineer becoming a frontier warden, durable rather than aristocratic. Quiet stone-and-heather backdrop; open top-right field; no text.
Input images: Image 1: primary dual-character hair, wardrobe, silhouette, and clean-graphic action anchor; exact fictional-adult project reference only.
Style/medium: premium cel-painted fantasy webcomic with mature clear-line contour hierarchy, restrained painterly color, strong silhouettes, readable equipment, and selective environment detail.
Identity invariant: Soren always has wavy light-brown to dark-blond hair, never black; Sigrid always has dark-brown to near-black tied-back hair, never blond. P050/P040 control identity; never copy P036 hair colors.
Adult boundary: every visible person is an unmistakably mature fictional adult with practical, non-sexualized proportions and clothing; no real-person likeness.
Equipment boundary: practical fantasy armor and weapons only, readable grip and load, no gore, injury, fetish treatment, giant decorative weapon, logo, watermark, caption, speech balloon, interface, or readable text.
